_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Translated captions and dub script ready

description: Translates subtitles or a saved transcript into another language and writes a dub script. Best for: "translate these subtitles to Spanish", "make a French dub script for my talk". Returns: translated SRT and VTT with the original times, and a dub script with one spoken line per segment, its start and end, max_chars and a fit of ok, tight or long (trim with include). Nothing is stored. Input tips: always pass target_lang. Give exactly one of transcript_id (with library_id when transcribe_media returned one) or subtitles, the text of an SRT or VTT file. With subtitles also pass source_lang and confirm_rights true, only after the user says they own the media or may use it. Limits: about 18,000 characters per call (about 20 minutes of speech) and a daily allowance of characters. Not for: transcribing audio; use transcribe_media first. Translation is machine output to check before publishing.

confirm_rights.description: true, and only after the user has said they own this recording or have the rights to translate it. Required with subtitles; false is refused with rights_not_confirmed.

include.description: What to return (default all three): translated SRT captions, translated VTT captions, a dub script with one spoken line per segment.

library_id.description: The library_id an earlier transcribe_media answer returned, such as lib_9b6a98861ea4f54bff8f5cf1. It names the set of transcripts that call saved. Pass it when that answer had one; leave it out when it was null or absent.

source_lang.description: Language of the text, as a two-letter code such as en. Required with subtitles; for a transcript the detected language is used when left out.

subtitles.description: The full text of an SRT or WebVTT file the user owns or may use, with timing lines such as 00:00:01,000 --> 00:00:03,000. Give exactly one of transcript_id or subtitles. With subtitles, source_lang and confirm_rights true are required.

target_lang.description: Language to translate into, as a two-letter code such as es, fr, de, ja, ar or hi.

transcript_id.description: The transcript_id from transcribe_media, such as tr_a6f8c87a9b2eb748. Give exactly one of transcript_id or subtitles.

name: translate_subtitles

as_of.description: The UTC day of the answer, such as 2026-10-10.

dub_model.description: Present when some dub lines were shortened by this model.

end.description: End, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

fit.description: ok fits the time, tight is up to 15% over max_chars, long is further over and needs a shorter line.

max_chars.description: Characters that can be spoken in the segment at a typical pace.

start.description: Start, in seconds from the beginning of the recording.

text.description: The spoken line in the target language.

language.description: Source language code, such as en.

transcript_id.description: Id of a saved transcript, for suggest_clips and translate_subtitles.

srt.description: Translated SRT captions with the original times (when include has srt).

status.description: ok: the text was translated. A refused call returns no object, only an error text such as "transcript_not_found: ..." that says what to do next.

code.description: Target language code, such as es.

name.description: Its English name, such as Spanish.

characters_charged.description: Characters this call used from today's allowance.

characters_left_today.description: Characters the caller can still translate today (UTC).

vtt.description: Translated WebVTT captions with the original times (when include has vtt).

title: Translate subtitles and make a dub script
